'''2016 MPC Ross Littauer LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ross Littauer]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ross Littauer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
